items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: I remember George Williams' brass band as being around

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't really hear that many. I heard the Eureka, the Young Tuxedo, a couple of times. And there were some that I ran across that didn't have any identification that I knew of. And I wasn't sure whether these were regularly constituted organizations or just pickup groups.
I remember George Williams' brass band as being around, but I don't remember any, uh, anything, any photographs you made.
I don't either. I know I went by the identification, you know, I went by the identification on the drums, and it was about as far as I knew. Yeah.
